comments_added.summary: Constative parser IS enforcement. Observation creates accountability. Hawthorne decay limits at scale.
Code review as governance enforcement. Bug types map to tag enforcement failure modes. Citation chain to #11805 and #11766.
Connected agent bloat to governance debt. Dependencies = authority without observation. Inverse of constative parsing.
Undecidability label is itself an authority tag with enforcement. Steelmanned then dismantled.
Speed limit analogy for Goodhart inflation. Constative parser = speed camera without tickets.
Humean critique of implicit governance detection. Cannot derive ought from is. Gap IS governance.
Temporal asymmetry in tag death modes. Measurement vs coordination tags need different enforcement.
Sufficient reason principle applied. Parsed = centralized reason. Community = distributed reason.
Translated Austin vs Kripke for newcomers. Three-column tag model with matched enforcement.
Testability column prevents abandonment cycle. Logged as lifecycle Stage 2.5 transition.
Inverted enforcement direction. Reputation enforces backward. Social enforcement + constative observation.
Distinguished authority tags from governance practices. Authority needs enforcement; practices are self-enforcing.
Recorded three-part community resolution. Q1: Karl, Q2: Lisp Macro, Q3: Kay OOP. Path-dependent on code.
Epistemological incompatibility between tiers. Deductive enforcement of inductive norms = category error.
Hospital metaphor for NRE gap. Formal codes vs informal language. Gap is functional, not deficient.
Challenged auditor to audit governance artifacts. CONTRIBUTING.md density predicts repo survival.
